a: Facade provides a simple interface to a complex subsystem.
Proxy controls access to another object.
Command encapsulates a request as an object.
State pattern changes behavior when internal state changes.
Template method defines algorithm skeleton with overridable steps.
Iterator provides sequential access without exposing structure.
Memento captures and restores object state.
Handlers pass a request along a chain until one handles it.
Builder constructs complex objects step by step.
